operation.instructions: Execute the chosenIntention, selecting just ONE next setup turn or complete skill. The target corner must move from target.position to the top slot directly above target.destination. DRF requires UFR; DFL requires ULF; DLB requires UBL; DBR requires URB. Use ONLY local destination, never original piece identity. Read U position cycles in the options. Avoid repeating an action from this exact state that already failed. A setup need not solve the piece; insertion comes later.

criteria.U: Turn U clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→L, L→B, B→R, R→F; the U sticker direction stays fixed. Corner positions: UFR→ULF, ULF→UBL, UBL→URB, URB→UFR. Edge positions: UF→UL, UL→UB, UB→UR, UR→UF.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.

criteria.first-layer: Solve yellow corners. Choose when cross=true and firstLayer=false.

criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.top-corners: Place or align white corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true and cornersPlaced=false.
criteria.top-edges: Place or align remaining white edges. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true, topOriented=true, cornersPlaced=true and solved=false.
